name: vcs-backend
description: Backend service for web-based Version Control System

scripts.build: npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('src/data')){fs.mkdirSync('dist/data',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('src/data','dist/data',{recursive:true});console.log('✅ Copied persistent data to dist/data')}"
